prompts.trainer: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production 2D fantasy RPG NPC sprite sheet, transparent background. Exactly 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows, eight full-body frames, no text, no grid lines. Each character centered in its cell with consistent fixed feet baseline, same scale and identity, ample empty padding so frames never touch. Thai Lanna fantasy village, charming detailed pixel-art game sprite, three-quarter facing right, readable at 112px tall. Top row four looping idle frames: breathe, blink, slight cloth motion, return. Bottom row four looping greeting frames with visibly moving arm and prop, return to initial pose. No floor shadow, no scenery. Male class trainer Ajarn Saeng, silver-haired wise Thai mentor, deep purple robe with gold trim, sash, wooden staff topped with warm golden light. Greeting animation raises free hand to cast a small golden class blessing; robe hem subtly moves.
